scope: Interactive UX mockup of the accepted Left open policy; no product implementation

workflow_ownership.Policies: Opening selection, allowed duration, monitoring hours, optional temperature source and limits, notification assignment, independent Save and Discard
workflow_ownership.Notifications: Shared notification timing and destination edits with the policy draft preserved
workflow_ownership.Prototype toolbar: Local theme controls and an explicitly illustrative behavior walkthrough

disclosures: Temperature fields appear only when outdoor-temperature qualification is selected.
Start and end fields appear only for daily monitoring hours.

rendered_review.disposition: ship the mockup for maintainer review
rendered_review.evidence: All four full-page captures, each top and scrolled viewport, and the illustrative behavior capture

Shared timing edits preserve destination and reminder edits
